==About Voicelines==
{{VO
|character                   = Rebecca
|language                    = en

<!-- Thoughts -->
|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = Gotta admit, Solaris ain't a bad place to live. But the peeps here are nova-level sticklers. So freakin' polite it's even got me swearin' less... Didn't know I could talk 'thout droppin' so many f*ckin' F-bombs.

|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = Say, you ever had a dog? I did, name was Cup-Cup. Cutest little scruffball you ever saw. Knew how to listen, too. Had his own threads, a dog tag, the whole deal. Man... slept a helluva lot warmer with him around...

|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = ...Y'know, never once stepped foot in a school. Everything I know 'bout stayin' alive, I learned on the streets. Constant threat of gettin' flatlined is the best education there is—just never know how high a price you're gonna pay... But hey, even if learnin' how to survive costs a literal arm and a leg, I still call that a bargain, choom.

|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = I can crash, like, literally anywhere. I mean, who needs a pillow when ya got hands?! Sure, fluffy bed's nice 'n' all, but once you've zonked out in a shot-up convertible on the street, you can get your beauty sleep any place, any time.

|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = I don't bother with "right n wrong," "pros and cons"... it's too damn exhaustin'. See somethin' tasty—scarf it down. Hear someone's bullsh*t—call 'em out. Land a gig—lock 'n' load. Strike it rich—hug your crew. Life doesn't gotta be complicated.


<!-- Miscellaneous -->
|vo_02_01_title              = Rebecca's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = What am I into? Do gig afterparties count? Nothing beats grabbin' a fizzy and plantin' myself on the hood of a car. My sh*thead brother clownin' around. Kiwi and Falco clinkin' glasses. Maine "mentoring" David, gettin' sloshed... Dorio tearin' him a new one. Even Lucy the loner would stick around... But I guess that's gone now.
|vo_02_01_mention            = Lucy

|vo_02_02_title              = Rebecca's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = I'm thinkin' all these Echoes are way too cool. Pickin' just one's killin' me! Can't you rig the Terminal to deploy all the Echoes you want at once? Turn a one-on-one into a full-on swarm. Now that'd be preem!

|vo_02_03_title              = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file               = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx                 = Pizza is peak. Cheap, easy and, most importantly, it's great party fuel. Perfect for sharin' while kickin' it with the crew.

|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = Food I won't eat...? Hmm... Nope, never heard of it!

|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = A dream? I guess... just makin' sure everyone gets to live a decent life? I dunno, choom. Too busy thinkin' about the next stunt we're gonna pull!


<!-- Chat -->
|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = Ya like Guts? My own custom job. Talks the talk, packs a mean punch. Before I chromed up my arms, the recoil would send me flyin'. Total pain in the buns.

|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = Becomin' an edgerunner wasn't my dream. Was what my pops wanted for me and my bro. Took a little while for things to click, but by the time we joined Maine's crew we'd already built ourselves a pretty savage rep... Whatever. All in the rearview now.


<!-- About Others -->
|vo_04_01_title              = About [[Lynae]]
|vo_04_01_intimacy           = 1
|vo_04_01_file               = {character}{language} About Lynae.ogg
|vo_04_01_tx                 = Lynae and I just click. Got a lot in common—graffiti, motorbikes, badass vibes... Even went racin'. I ate her dust, but whatevs. Not many students 'round here are as nova as she is. Rare breed for sure. Be cool as hell if I got to be her classmate.
|vo_04_01_mention            = Lynae

|vo_04_02_title              = About [[Lucy]]
|vo_04_02_intimacy           = 2
|vo_04_02_file               = {character}{language} About Lucy.ogg
|vo_04_02_tx                 = Lucy... Dunno where to even start. Known her a while now, but can't say I really get her, y'know? Far as her netrunnin' skills go, she's a freakin' code wizard, can't deny that. I guess... no matter what, Lucy's crew. That answer your question?
|vo_04_02_mention            = Lucy

|vo_04_03_title              = About [[Mornye]]
|vo_04_03_intimacy           = 3
|vo_04_03_file               = {character}{language} About Mornye.ogg
|vo_04_03_tx                 = Mornye's chrome legs and what I've got installed are toootally different. Hers are see-through! Can look right through 'em 'thout seein' a single wire or chip! Like, how's that even work? Uses 'em like she was born with 'em, like the kid's had 'em since forever—Wait, what...? She's OLDER than me?! The hell?!
|vo_04_03_mention            = Mornye

|vo_04_04_title              = About [[Luuk Herssen]]
|vo_04_04_intimacy           = 4
|vo_04_04_file               = {character}{language} About Luuk Herssen.ogg
|vo_04_04_tx                 = At first, he gave me creepy scavenger vibes. Boy, was I wrong. Hear he's good at patchin' peeps up, even their minds. Might let him scan my skull sponge when the dust settles. See if my grayware needs tuning, or if I'm just a certified whackjob.
|vo_04_04_mention            = Luuk Herssen

|vo_04_05_title              = About [[Sigrika]]
|vo_04_05_intimacy           = 5
|vo_04_05_file               = {character}{language} About Sigrika.ogg
|vo_04_05_tx                 = Sigrika's a good kid. Too good. Bein' that responsible, with everyone expectin' so much...? Gotta be exhaustin'. She oughta cut loose more. Go wild sometimes, y'know? ...Speakin' of, think she'd be down to hit the arcade with me next weekend?
|vo_04_05_mention            = Sigrika


<!-- Birthday -->
|vo_05_01_title              = Birthday Wishes
|vo_05_01_file               = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg
|vo_05_01_tx                 = It's your freakin' birthday, choom! That's a once-a-year license to raise hell! We're throwin' a rager, downin' bottles 'til sunrise! ...Oh, guess some peeps can't drink yet... Fiiiine, guess we'll make do with fizzy sodas!
